sets.title: Held-out layouts
sets.description: four layouts made after the rules and prompts were fixed, and never used to change them: totals above the line items with dates written out ("the 3rd of September 2026"), a GST-inclusive shop invoice with "Amount payable" and "GST content" and no subtotal, a detailed layout with two-digit-year dates that includes a two-page invoice and a credit note, and a tenancy summary written as a letter.
